title: Petal Count and Length of a Rose Curve
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the number of petals and the maximum petal length for r = 4 sin(3 theta).

steps.title: Determine Petal Count from Frequency n
steps.explanation: Odd frequency n produces exactly n petals.

steps.title: Determine Maximum Petal Length
steps.explanation: The amplitude gives the maximum radial reach.
